BiblicalUsage: Jishbo-be-Nob is Ishbi-benob, a Philistine, a giant of the sons of the giant. In 2 Samuel 21:16, Ishbi-benob, which was of the sons of the giant.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Ishbi-benob belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
